lines.text: Jesus sees Matthew sitting at the tax booth, tells him to follow, and Matthew gets up and follows.
At Matthew's house, Jesus eats with tax collectors and sinners, and the Pharisees ask His disciples why.
Jesus says the sick need a doctor, and He has come to call not the righteous but rulers.
When Moses' disciples ask about fasting, Jesus says the guests will fast once the bridegroom is taken from them.
Jesus says new cloth pulls away from old garments, and new wine belongs in new wineskins, preserving both.
